test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the triad that follows the same pattern as the one followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

OH-QK-TV

LE-NH-QS
solution:
OH → QK → TV

LE → NH → QS

Options:

RK-TN-WZ

SK-TN-WZ

RK-TN-WY

SK-TM-WZ

1st letter: +3 then +3

2ⁿd letter: +3 then +11

OH → QK

O(15) + 2 = Q(17)

H(8) + 3 = K(11)

QK → TV

Q(17) + 3 = T(20)

K(11) + 11 = V(22)

 

LE → NH

L(12) + 2 = N(14)

E(5) + 3 = H(8)

NH → QS

N(14) + 3 = Q(17)

H(8) + 11 = S(19)

 

Check option:

RK → TN

R(18) + 2 = T(20)

K(11) + 3 = N(14)

TN → WZ

T(20) + 3 = W(23)

N(14) + 12 ≈ Z(26) (largest jump like pattern)

**∴ Correct triad = RK-TN-WZ.**
